ad_intro:
Why a performance-marketing audit includes the website: Meta does not make you money - the click does. CPL is paid on the ad; the conversion happens on the landing page, the form, WhatsApp speed-to-lead and the proof. Sudarshan Saur has just earned the single most valuable credential in Indian residential solar - an ALMM listing - and the website spends its first screen on a footnote that says the plant is still being installed, above seven achievement counters that all render 0.

Sudarshan Saur Shakti Pvt. Ltd., established 1989, HQ K-240 & 241, MIDC Waluj, Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar (Aurangabad), Maharashtra - note the Day-1 file says Pune, which is wrong. Founder director Sanjay Appa Bargaje (with Anjali Jintoorkar, Sangeeta Bargaje, Sanjay Jintoorkar). India's ETC pioneer (2002), first to glass-lined ETC (2016), first in India to get ISI certification and a star rating for ETC solar water heaters (2021), national awards for Highest Sales and Best Service Network. 5.7 lakh families served, 350+ dealers.

The news the site is under-selling: a 250 MW fully automated module plant was inaugurated on 24 Nov 2025 in Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar, and in May 2026 Sudarshan Saur Shakti entered MNRE's ALMM List-I as a new entrant with 360 MW (Energetica India / MNRE, total list then 193 GW). Product: TOPCon N-Type M10R & G12R bifacial, 16-busbar, glass-to-glass, anodised frame, low PID/LID, 3-point EL testing, Tongwei raw material, 25-year performance warranty - plus the legacy water-heater line and the Fiidotherm heat pump. Day-1 file 14 Sep 2026: 6/10, ~4 ads, Lead Form dest, Rs.1-3 L/mo est., pitch_fit HIGH.

Live check 14 Sep 2026: the homepage ticker correctly announces the ALMM listing - then the hero reads 'Now Manufacturing Next-Gen Solar Panels' with the footnote '*Plant installation is in progress', while the timeline says the plant became operational in 2024 and news says Nov 2025. All seven 'Key statistics' counters (States, Districts, Coal Saved, Units Saved, Trees Saved, Dealer Network, Happy Families) display 0. Two product tiles link to #aa and #bb anchors. 'Latest News' items all link to #. No price anywhere. Subsidy appears exactly once, buried in a PV FAQ: 'Yes, there is a Union Ministry subsidy scheme available' - no scheme name, no rupee. Testimonials are institutional text (Ramakrishna Mission, D.Y. Patil, Sanjay Ghodawat, Land Development Bank) with no photos. WhatsApp is live at 7770066008. Real Marathi and English PDF brochures exist and are never used as creative.

Day-1 leak, confirmed. Ad counts are Day-1 estimates. Never promise subsidy approval.
ad_intelligence: Ad Library is 30% of the leak. The other 70%: (1) does the landing match the hook, (2) can they WhatsApp in under 5 minutes, (3) is there proof a neighbour installed, (4) is the form short, (5) does tracking fire on enquire/WhatsApp not just PageView. Sudarshan Saur passes (2) and (4) - WhatsApp is live and the form is 4 fields. It fails (1) badly: the ad promises next-gen panels, the page's first screen says the plant is still being installed and every achievement number reads 0.

Meta (FB @sudarshansaurshakti + IG @saursudarshan) - note the Day-1 handle @sudarshansaur is wrong. Also X @SaurSudarshan, LinkedIn, YouTube. Google Search on 'solar water heater price', 'ETC water heater', 'solar panel dealer Maharashtra'. Separate dealer portal at sudarshansaur.net and a sister brand site fiidotherm.com for heat pumps. Channel-led: 350+ dealers do the closing.

~4 creatives by Day-1 signature at Rs.1-3 L/mo - the lowest-volume lead in this cohort, running in the same quarter the company got ALMM-listed. Verify in Meta Ad Library India (active filter) searching both 'Sudarshan Saur' and 'Sudarshan Solar' - trade press uses both names. Do not quote 4 as a hard number.

PV: SSSPL TOPCon N-Type M10R & G12R bifacial, 16 busbar, glass-to-glass dual glass, anodised aluminium frame, low PID/LID, 3-point EL testing, Tongwei-sourced cells, MNRE/IEC certified, PID-free, 25-year performance warranty, ALMM List-I 360 MW. Water heaters: ETC and FPC, glass-lined, ISI + star-rated (India first, 2021). Fiidotherm heat pumps. Claim: combined PV + water heater cuts bills up to 90% (PV page says 80%). No MRP or per-kW band published on any of it.

Ad -> sudarshansaur.com -> 'Enquiry Now' (Name, Phone, Email, Requirement) or 'Request a Quote' on /contact, plus a floating WhatsApp button (7770066008, prefilled 'Hello There I want to buy a Solar'). Two homepage product tiles point at dead #aa / #bb anchors; all five 'Latest News' cards link to '#'. Marathi and English brochure PDFs plus a technical leaflet exist on the PV page. No dealer locator on the main site - dealers sit behind sudarshansaur.net.

PM Surya Ghar requires ALMM-listed modules for subsidy eligibility - 50.06 lakh homes, 16,185 MW, Rs.28,024 Cr disbursed, ~16,328 installs/day, scheme loans at 5.75% (MNRE, Aug 2026). Sudarshan Saur joined ALMM List-I in May 2026 with 360 MW. That makes every module they sell subsidy-eligible - a fact worth more than any creative refresh, and it appears nowhere except a scrolling ticker and one vague FAQ line.
findings: You are ALMM-listed and you are not selling it (confirmed 14 Sep 2026). In May 2026 MNRE added Sudarshan Saur Shakti to ALMM List-I as a new entrant with 360 MW. Under PM Surya Ghar, only ALMM-listed modules qualify for central assistance - so every panel you make is now subsidy-eligible. On the site this appears as a scrolling ticker and, in a PV FAQ, the sentence 'Yes, there is a Union Ministry subsidy scheme available'. No scheme name. No rupee. Replace it with: ALMM-listed, so your rooftop qualifies for PM Surya Ghar central assistance - Rs.30,000 / Rs.60,000 / Rs.78,000 for 1 / 2 / 3+ kW, DBT, scheme loans at 5.75% - plus 'MNRE process; Sudarshan Saur does not approve subsidy'.

Seven achievement counters and every one of them reads 0. States Across India: 0. Districts Served: 0. Tonnes of Coal Saved Daily: 0. Units of Electricity Saved Daily: 0. Trees Saved Daily: 0. Dealer Network: 0. Happy Families: 0. The JavaScript count-up is not firing, so a 35-year-old company with 5.7 lakh families and 350+ dealers presents itself to every paid click as a company that has done nothing. Hard-code the numbers as static text. This is a one-hour fix that is currently taxing every rupee of media spend.

Your hero contradicts itself on whether the factory exists. The first slide says 'Now Manufacturing Next-Gen Solar Panels' with the footnote '*Plant installation is in progress'. The journey timeline says the 250 MW plant became operational in 2024. Trade press reports the inauguration on 24 Nov 2025. ALMM listed you in May 2026. A buyer spending Rs.1.5-3 lakh reads that footnote as 'they cannot supply yet'. Pick one true statement - 250 MW plant operational, ALMM-listed, shipping - and delete the footnote.

Day-1 leak confirmed: no subsidy note on the product page, and no proof a human owns one. Testimonials are institutional letter-text - Ramakrishna Mission, D.Y. Patil College, Sanjay Ghodawat Institute, Land Development Bank Kolhapur, a 53,500 LPD installation - impressive B2B references with zero photos, zero video, zero homeowners. 5.7 lakh families is the single largest UGC asset in this Day-1 cohort and not one of them is on camera. Meanwhile Marathi and English brochure PDFs and a technical leaflet already exist and have never been cut into creative.

Dead links inside the conversion path. Two of the three homepage product tiles point at anchors #aa and #bb that go nowhere; all five 'Latest News' cards link to #. The PV FAQ contains a garbled question - 'How much eHow do solar panels work when it's cloudy?nergy can I generate?' - visible to every visitor. There is no dealer locator on the main site despite 350+ dealers being the actual sales force; dealers are hidden behind a separate sudarshansaur.net portal. Each of these is a small leak; together they signal a site nobody is tending.

No price, and a savings claim that changes between pages. The homepage says the PV + water heater combination reduces bills 'up to 90%'; the PV page says 'up to 80%'; the FAQ says 80-90% with a 4-5 year payback. No MRP, no per-kW band, no kit pricing anywhere. For a dealer-led D2C brand, publishing an indicative from-Rs. band plus a 3-field savings estimator does not undercut the 350+ dealers - it qualifies the lead before it reaches them, which is exactly what a dealer network wants.
competitors: ALMM prominence, DCR/Non-DCR clarity per SKU, residential nav with CFA rupees, active dealer locators.
You are now on the same ALMM List-I they are. Say it on the first screen instead of in a ticker, and the 35-year service record beats them on trust.
Marketplace listings, published MRP, EMI messaging, review counts.
You are India's ETC pioneer and the first with ISI + star rating - and you publish no price. The legacy category is being lost on commerce UX, not product.
Unboxing and terrace Reels, Marathi content, WhatsApp-first, 3-field quotes.
You have WhatsApp live and Marathi brochures already. Turn the brochure into 15 Marathi Reels and you out-proof them instantly with 5.7 lakh families.
Where the actual selling happens - and it is invisible from the ad path.
Add a dealer locator to the main site and route ad traffic to the nearest of your 350+ dealers with a tracked handoff.
wins: WIN 1 - 48 hours: lead with ALMM + PM Surya Ghar, hard-code the counters, kill the contradiction

Rewrite the first screen: 'ALMM-listed (MNRE List-I, 360 MW) - our TOPCon N-Type modules qualify for PM Surya Ghar central assistance of up to Rs.78,000' with the exact 1/2/3 kW slabs and the disclaimer 'MNRE process; Sudarshan Saur does not approve subsidy'. Delete '*Plant installation is in progress' and state the 250 MW plant is operational. Replace the seven zero counters with static text: 35 years, 5.7 lakh families, 350+ dealers, 250 MW capacity. Fix the #aa / #bb tiles and the garbled FAQ. Expected: the category's strongest credential finally enters the funnel; 25-40% more qualified enquiries at the same spend.
WIN 2 - 7 days: price band, savings estimator, dealer locator, and a real conversion event

Publish an indicative from-Rs. per-kW band and water-heater MRP range, add a 3-field estimator (city, monthly bill, roof area) that captures the phone number before showing payback, and put a dealer locator on the main site that routes to the right one of your 350+ dealers with a tracked handoff. Fire distinct pixel events on estimator-complete, WhatsApp-click and dealer-locator use so Meta optimises on intent instead of PageView. Reconcile the 80% vs 90% savings claim to one number. Expected: 1.5-2x form completion and a dealer network that receives qualified, not cold, leads.
WIN 3 - 14 days: 20 Marathi/Hindi UGC Reels from 5.7 lakh families + 60-day retargeting

You already have Marathi and English brochures and a technical leaflet - cut them into creative, then shoot 20 real installs across Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar, Pune, Kolhapur and Nashik: terrace before/after, net meter, the family reading the old vs new bill, in Marathi and Hindi. Add photos to the institutional testimonials (Ramakrishna Mission, D.Y. Patil, Ghodawat) - a 53,500 LPD system is a spectacular visual that exists only as text. Audiences: estimator abandoners, WhatsApp non-repliers, 50% video viewers, brochure downloaders - 60-day windows. Expected: Day-1 leak closed and creative that can finally justify scaling past Rs.3 L/mo.
